verdict.rationale: Natural-language-to-command generation is a fair question for a terminal emulator, since AI-assisted terminals exist, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI or natural-language command generation in Ghostty. One user switching back to Warp because Ghostty was 'too barebones' does not establish anything specific about this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can type natural language and get the right shell command generated in place
